column1: App Name : Forklift Daily Pre-Start Checklist App
column3: Tested By : Harini
Description
column4: Test Step
column5: Expected Result

column3: Verify Forklift Unit dropdown lists all registered units
column4: 1) Load Checklist UI; 2) Click Forklift Unit dropdown
column5: All registered forklift units (e.g. FLT-001 to FLT-006) are listed with unit name and model

column3: Verify Inspector and Inspection Date auto-populate
column4: 1) Load Checklist UI
column5: Inspector field pre-fills with logged-in user's name; Inspection Date defaults to current date/time (MYT)

column3: Verify all 17 checklist items are displayed
column4: 1) Scroll through Standardized Pre-Start Checklist table
column5: All 17 categories are listed in order from Forks and Load Handling to Operating Environment

column3: Verify each checklist item can be marked Pass or Fail
column4: 1) Toggle the Check column for a checklist item
column5: Item updates to a green check (Pass) or red flag (Fail) accordingly

column3: Verify Remarks field is required when an item is marked Fail
column4: 1) Mark an item as Fail; 2) Leave Remarks blank; 3) Attempt to submit
column5: System requires a remark to be entered before the checklist can be submitted for a failed item

column3: Verify View Criteria link opens correct inspection criteria
column4: 1) Click "View Criteria" for any checklist item
column5: A criteria reference/description relevant to that specific item is displayed

column3: Verify checklist with all items passed routes ticket to Operating
column4: 1) Mark all 17 items as Pass; 2) Submit checklist
column5: Ticket status updates to "Operating" and forklift becomes available for use

column3: Verify checklist with one or more Fail items routes ticket to Awaiting Review
column4: 1) Mark at least one item as Fail with a remark; 2) Submit checklist
column5: Ticket status updates to "Awaiting Review" instead of "Operating"

column3: Verify AI analysis triggers only when status = Awaiting Review
column4: 1) Submit a checklist with no failed items; 2) Submit a separate checklist with a failed item
column5: AI Defect Analysis workflow does not run for the all-pass ticket; it runs automatically for the ticket with a failed item

column3: Verify AI-suggested action is generated from the flagged defect remark
column4: 1) Submit a checklist with a Brake Systems defect remark; 2) Wait for workflow to complete
column5: Ticket is updated with an AI Summary, Analysis, and Suggested Action relevant to the brake defect before reaching the PIC Inspector Portal

column3: Verify AI output handles multiple simultaneous defects on one ticket
column4: 1) Submit a checklist with 2 failed items (e.g. Tires and Brakes) in the same ticket
column5: AI Summary reflects both flagged defects rather than only the first one, or clearly attributes each suggested action to its item
column6: AI Summary only referenced the first flagged defect (Brake Systems) and omitted the Tires remark on a dual-defect ticket

column3: Verify Awaiting Review queue lists all tickets pending PIC decision
column4: 1) Load Forklift Inspector Portal
column5: Table shows Ticket ID, Forklift Unit, Inspector, Inspection Date, Defect Category/Status, Ticket Status, and Original Remarks for all Awaiting Review tickets

column3: Verify clicking View opens the correct ticket's defect review panel
column4: 1) Click "View" on a specific ticket row
column5: Inspection Defect Review & Decision panel loads with matching Ticket ID and defect remark

column3: Verify AI Defect Analysis Outcome displays correctly in the review panel
column4: 1) Open a ticket that has completed AI analysis
column5: AI Summary severity tag (e.g. [CRITICAL SAFETY HAZARD]), Analysis, and Suggested Actions are shown in the review panel

column3: Verify Approve (Operating) action updates ticket and forklift status
column4: 1) Open a ticket; 2) Click "Approve (Operating)"
column5: Ticket status changes to Operating, forklift becomes available, and ticket is removed from the Awaiting Review queue

column3: Verify Route to Maintenance action updates ticket and forklift status
column4: 1) Open a ticket; 2) Click "Route to Maintenance"
column5: Ticket status changes to Maintenance, forklift is marked unavailable, and ticket is removed from the Awaiting Review queue

column3: Verify Close action exits the review panel without changing ticket status
column4: 1) Open a ticket; 2) Click "Close" without selecting an action
column5: Review panel closes and ticket remains in Awaiting Review with no status change

column3: Verify PIC decisions and remarks are recorded on the same ticket
column4: 1) Approve or route a ticket to maintenance
column5: PIC decision, timestamp, and any remarks are saved to the same ticket record for traceability

column3: Verify Maintenance Release returns a forklift to Operating status
column4: 1) Complete repair on a Maintenance-status forklift; 2) Submit Maintenance Release
column5: Ticket status updates from Maintenance to Operating, and forklift becomes available again

column3: Verify Shut Down action is available from Operating status
column4: 1) Select a forklift with Operating status; 2) Trigger Shut Down
column5: Ticket status updates to Shut Down and forklift is marked unavailable for new checklist submissions

column3: Verify KPI cards reflect accurate real-time counts
column4: 1) Load Dashboard; 2) Compare Operating, Maintenance, Pending PIC, and Shut Down KPI values against the underlying ticket records
column5: Sum of Operating + Maintenance + Pending PIC + Shut Down counts equals Total Fleet (Registered Tickets)
column6: KPI cards showed Operating 4 + Maintenance 1 + Pending PIC 3 + Shut Down 1 = 9, but Total Fleet displayed 6 Registered Tickets. Root cause: KPI cards were counting cumulative tickets per unit instead of each unit's current status only.

column3: Verify Forklift Operations Chart matches per-unit ticket history
column4: 1) Compare stacked bar chart segments for each unit against that unit's ticket history
column5: Each bar's status segments (Preparation/Awaiting Review/Operating/Maintenance/Shut Down) match the unit's actual ticket record history

column3: Verify Fleet Status Pie Chart percentages sum to 100%
column4: 1) Load Dashboard; 2) Sum all pie chart status percentages
column5: Percentages for Operating/Preparation/Review/Maintenance/Shut Down sum to 100% and reflect current fleet-wide distribution

column3: Verify Select Forklift to Inspect dropdown opens the correct ticket
column4: 1) Select a forklift unit from the dropdown; 2) Click "Open Ticket"
column5: The correct, currently active ticket for the selected forklift unit opens
